review: Tự soạn theo RSpec model/request specs,FactoryBot,Shoulda docs. Source thiếu rails_helper/config/factories/auth_headers/json_body. Assertions là ý định,chưa có Ruby/RSpec/DB execution. Request GET chỉ tạo published nên chưa negative-test draft filtering.
